modeHint.varied: Selected windows repeat the main window’s actions with random delays and natural pointer movements.

card.captcha: Each profile handles its own CAPTCHA. Input pauses in the solving tab; other tabs continue. Release a window to solve a failed challenge manually, then resume.
card.nextStart: Mode, action and delay changes apply the next time synchronization starts.

security.unsupported: Encrypted profile storage is currently available only on macOS.
security.recoveredHint: You signed in with a recovery code. If you lost access to your previous authenticator, replace it now. For the next five minutes, entering your password again is enough to start replacement.
security.migrationPendingHint: Your password and 2FA are set up, but data migration has not finished. Unlock profiles to resume migration. Profiles remain unavailable until it completes.
security.title: Local encrypted storage
security.bannerText: Opening profiles will require a separate password and a code from an authenticator app. Data will be stored encrypted.
security.setupHint: Protect profiles with a password and an authenticator code. Setup is optional: all app features are available without 2FA.
security.unlockHint: Enter your password and 2FA code. Verification lasts until the app closes.
security.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. Both passwords must match.
security.protectedHint: Enter your password and verification code to access encrypted profiles. Access lasts until you close the application. On exit, browsers close and storage is locked.
security.scanHint: Scan the QR code in an authenticator app or add the key manually. Then enter the six-digit code it generates.
security.qrAlt: QR code to add Ombra to your authenticator
security.recoveryHint: Save these codes somewhere separate from this computer. Each code replaces 2FA verification once; your password is still required. Changing your password or authenticator invalidates previous recovery codes.
security.recoverySaved: I saved the recovery codes in a safe place
security.migrationHint: Enabling protection closes profile browsers and restarts Ombra. Enter your password and a new 2FA code to move profiles and the database into the encrypted vault. Keep the app open during migration.
security.protecting: Saving protection settings and restarting the app…
